ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels; estimated ratio is approximately 98:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Visible surface is devoid of large contiguous white geometric blobs; pixel data indicates a stochastic distribution of high-contrast white stippling and micro-clusters across both lobes without distinct solid banding.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary exhibiting high-frequency variations; right lobe trailing edge shows 8-10 distinct pixel-amplitude peaks (5-12 pixels in height), while the left lobe shows 6-8 peaks of lower relative amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge, originating at the notch and sweeping upward to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) detected; higher density of clusters observed on the right lobe surface compared to the left.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned high-contrast white linear tracks; notable 40-pixel horizontal track on the mid-upper right lobe and several 10-15 pixel diagonal tracks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized accumulation of orange-hued pixels (non-pigment) on the far terminal margin of the left fluke tip; high-intensity textured cluster visible on the far right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of distinct orange-brown material at the left distal extremity that disrupts the continuous dark pixel boundary of the fluke edge.
